## ✨ Good First Issue

**Description**
A clear and concise description of what needs to be done.

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expect to happen after this is implemented.

**Suggested approach**
If you have ideas on how to implement this, describe them here.

**Files likely to be touched**
- [ ] `apps/api/app/` — Python FastAPI service code
- [ ] `apps/api/tests/` — Backend tests
- [ ] `docs/` — Documentation
- [ ] `research/` — Disease catalog, models, evidence
- [ ] `artifacts/` — Test evidence gates
- [ ] `packages/` — Shared contracts

**Estimated effort**
- [ ] Small (~1-2 hours)
- [ ] Medium (~3-5 hours)
- [ ] Large (1+ day)

**Prerequisites**
- Python 3.11+
- Familiarity with FastAPI/Pydantic
- Understanding of deny-by-default synthetic-only boundary
